teaser: Life path 1 is the number of the person who starts things, and ENFP is the type that falls in love with starting them. Put the two in one chair and you get someone who can see three new directions before breakfast and feels a genuine pull toward all three. The 1 wants a single thread followed to the end. The ENFP in you keeps noticing better thread. What is particular here is not the ideas, which come easily either way, but the odd discipline of choosing one, out loud, and staying in the room after the choosing.
excerpt: "You already knew what you wanted to do before you asked what I thought," a partner might say, halfway through unpacking the amp cases at a half-empty rehearsal space you booked without much discussion.
